title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1, and words like recycle, stream and tear are new to many.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use red, blue and green for different pipes; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette or line style that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Feed, recycle and product pipes distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: Newton solving of the tear stream
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Newton's method with a numerical Jacobian converges in a few steps where substitution needs 18.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a JSON file format for flowsheets
body:
## Problem
Flowsheets are Python dictionaries; a graphical editor needs a file format.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 4.

## Expected outcome
`save_flowsheet` and `load_flowsheet` functions with a JSON schema and a test that the mini-project round-trips.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Round trip gives recycle flow 146.66 mol/s
- [ ] A missing setting gives the under-specified message

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: animated flowsheet with a converging recycle
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows pipes sized by flow while a recycle iterates and a flash temperature sweeps; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Pipe widths follow the flows at every frame
- [ ] Convergence curve of at least two solvers shown
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
